messages:
ana: heads-up — after the kernel selector change (moved more traffic to unified-attn) we see a 10-14% drop in batch_utilization on p3-prod, queue_depth up, and tokens/sec down. throwing this here for triage.

sam: can you paste the quick numbers and which model(s) were affected?

ana: (typo) actually ana: quick snapshot from last hour: `model: redwood-3b-unq`, `kernel: unified-attn-v2`, `batch_util=0.62 -> 0.54` (baseline ~0.70), `queue_depth_p95: 12 -> 36`, `tokens_per_sec: 45k -> 38k`, `kv_cache_hitrate: 0.78 -> 0.61`. saw the regression start at deploy 2024-11-09T14:12Z.

marta: hmm KV hitrate drop is suspicious — did the deploy change cache keying or eviction windows?

ana: no explicit keying changes. profiler snippet from a canary run:
```
# timeline (sample)
0.000s kernel_select: cost_est=1.2
0.003s batch_formation: waiting_for_token_budget (avg wait 6ms)
0.012s kv_lookup (miss): 0.8ms
0.020s attn_kernel_exec unified-attn-v2: 3.6ms
```
shows increased wait in batch_formation and more kv misses.

leo: could be heuristic shift: unified-attn reduced per-request compute so batcher mixes longer sequences -> more KV churn, lower prefix overlap. Also kernel latency distribution might be wider, hurting batching windows.

sam: we need concrete telemetry panels. proposal: add per-model, per-kernel panels for: `batch_utilization` (avg/p95), `queue_depth` (p50/p95), `tokens_per_sec`, `kv_cache_hitrate`, `batch_wait_ms` and `kernel_latency_p50/p95`. set alert if batch_util < 0.6 for 5m OR tokens_per_sec drops >15% over baseline.

ana: agreed. also add a panel for `kernel_selection_fraction` (how much traffic each kernel gets) and a breakdown of sequence-length mix (<=64, 65-256, 256+). that will show if seq mix changed.

rachel: can we also capture `token_budget_fill_rate` and `avg_wait_before_dispatch`? those are direct levers for the continuous-batching heuristics.

marta: yes — and a useful alert: queue_depth_p95 > 30 AND kv_cache_hitrate < 0.65 -> page oncall. both conditions needed to avoid false positives.

deploy-bot: deploy 2024-11-09T14:12Z (canary) -> kernel-selector:unified-attn-v2 rolled to 10% -> 50% traffic.

leo: proposal for dashboard layout: row1: traffic by kernel (pie + timeseries), row2: batch_util + batch_wait_ms, row3: queue_depth + tokens_per_sec, row4: kv_cache_hitrate + seq_length_hist. keep per-route filters.

sam: who owns making these Grafana panels + alert rules? can we get a short-lived dashboard in observability sandbox to validate?

ana: I can prototype panels (small PR) and put suggested alert thresholds. will instrument an extra metric `batcher_kernel_latency_variance` in the runtime for a couple hours to see distribution.

marta: i'll run a targeted A/B: rollback kernel selector in one canary pool and compare kv_hitrate & batch_util for 30m.

rachel: add a short smoke check in the CI that asserts tokens_per_sec doesn't regress >10% post-merge for the next 24h.

sam: timeline? ana/marta/rachel owners?

an a: ana: i'll do the dashboard draft today, marta: you own the A/B and data capture, rachel: add the CI smoke, leo: you'll help interpret the profiling output. i'll open a tracking issue and link the dashboard PR.

leo: tiny optimization thought — try relaxing output batch timeout by +2ms in canary to see if batch_util recovers without hurting p95 latency. low risk.

marta: running the rollback A/B now (will post summary in this thread).

deploy-bot: rollback started for canary-pool-3 at 2024-11-09T15:02Z.

ana: thanks all — will follow up with dashboard link and PR. ping @oncall if alerts trip. :thumbsup:
